technical_case_records.original_stem: Conductorul neutru (N) trebuie să aibă aceeaşi secţiune cu conductorul de fază:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.A: în circuitele monofazate cu două conductoare, indiferent de secţiunea conductoarelor
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.B: în circuitele monofazate cu trei conductoare şi în circuitele polifazate ale căror conductoare de fază au secţiunea mai mică sau egală cu 25 mm2 Cu sau 35 mm2 Al
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: în circuitele monofazate cu trei conductoare şi în circuitele polifazate indiferent de secţiunea conductoarelor de fază

negative_option_QA.A: AFFIRMATIVE: monophase 2-conductor N equals phase any cross-section
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED: 3-conductor monophase + 25 mm2 Cu / 35 mm2 Al are not conditions specified by source; polyphase thresholds are 16 Cu/25 Al
negative_option_QA.C: OVERGENERALIZED: polyphase all sizes not universal; neutral may differ in qualified cases §5.2.4.6.3

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Polyphase conductors over 16 Cu / 25 Al with balanced load, lower harmonics and protected N may permit smaller N §5.2.4.6.3
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Utilizarea conductelor metalice pentru apă drept conductoare de protecţie:

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED: water pipes not recommended as PE
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED: the cited subsection prohibits as PE, with no permission in this object
negative_option_QA.C: AFFIRMATIVE: source expressly prohibits using water pipes as protection conductors

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Equipotential bonding to metallic pipes is a separate activity; it cannot be treated as permission to replace a PE conductor
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Îmbinarea tuburilor de protecţie a conductoarelor electrice la trecerile prin elemente de construcţie este:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: admisă doar pentru tuburi cu diametru mai mic de 16 mm

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED: joints at construction penetrations expressly forbidden
negative_option_QA.B: AFFIRMATIVE: exact source wording forbids joints
negative_option_QA.C: CONTRADICTED: no diameter <16mm exception to this ban in cited subsection

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Tube joints permitted with adequate accessories outside the penetration (§5.2.12.3.1–3), but not at penetrations
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Utilizarea unei singure culori pentru toate conductoarele de fază ale unui circuit

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.B: este permisă, cu marcarea corespunzătoare la cele două extremităţi
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: este permisă dacă nu se folosește una dintre culorile verde sau galben

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED: a single phase-conductor color can be allowed
negative_option_QA.B: AFFIRMATIVE: explicitly allowed only with identification at both ends
negative_option_QA.C: INSUFFICIENT: the alternative lacks mandatory both-end identification; advice about green/yellow alone does not exhaust conditions

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: All phase wires colored brown but no identification at both ends fails the wording of §5.1.4.3.3 despite avoiding green/yellow
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Amplasarea instalaţiilor electrice sub conducte sau utilaje pe care poate să apară condens:

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED: not always allowed below condensate-producing pipes/equipment
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED: there is an explicit exception
negative_option_QA.C: AFFIRMATIVE: permitted subject to closed construction, minimum IP33 and material resistance

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Below condensation-prone equipment without IP33-rated closed resistant execution is prohibited
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Instalarea conductoarelor electrice în tuburi sau ţevi pozate în pământ:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: este admisă numai pentru conductoare de cupru

negative_option_QA.A: AFFIRMATIVE: direct wording prohibits electrical conductors in buried conduits
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED for conductors covered by §5.2.12.1.4; generic allowed alternative wrong under same object
negative_option_QA.C: CONTRADICTED: the norm has no copper-only allowance for those conductors

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Do not generalize this prohibition to all fully rated underground cable types without checking separate cable-installation provisions and precise definition of conductoare vs cabluri
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: În instalaţiile de joasă tensiune aferente clădirilor, rezistenţa electrică a izolaţiei trebuie măsurată:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.B: numai între conductoarele active luate 2 câte 2
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: între conductoarele active şi conductorul de protecţie conectat la reţeaua de legare la pământ

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED by exclusive 'numai': requires active-to-PE testing, not only a pair of active conductors
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED by exclusive 'numai': requires active-to-PE testing; note active conductors may be interconnected for this measurement
negative_option_QA.C: AFFIRMATIVE: matches explicit measured relationship active conductors-to-earthed PE

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Optional additional active-to-active tests cannot replace explicitly required active-to-PE measurement
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: I7 listed for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 14

technical_case_records.original_stem: Branşamentul electric este partea din instalaţia de distribuţie a energiei electrice cuprinsă între linia electrică şi:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: punctul de delimitare între distribuitor şi consumator, reprezentat de bornele contorului

negative_option_QA.A: CONTRADICTED: between line and firidă defines RACORD, only part of full branșament
negative_option_QA.B: NOT COMPLETE: column is another component, not complete boundary
negative_option_QA.C: CLOSEST SOURCE SUPPORTED: delivery/consumer separation at meter OUTPUT terminals; original C misses word 'ieșire'

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: If the boundary is stated as any arbitrary meter terminal rather than the output terminal, C is imprecise; source-specific qualifier is mandatory
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: PE155/1992 marked DA for Grade I and II in ANRE May 2023 official bibliography item 29

technical_case_records.original_stem: Siguranţele cu capac filetat trebuie să fie montate în aşa fel încât:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.A: conductoarele de alimentare să fie legate la şuruburile de contact
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.B: conductoarele de plecare spre consumatori să fie legate la şuruburile de contact
original_ABC_UNCHANGED.C: conductoarele de alimentare să fie legate la duliile filetate

negative_option_QA.A: AFFIRMATIVE: feed-side wires connect to contact screws
negative_option_QA.B: CONTRADICTED: outgoing to consumers are connected to threaded sockets/dulii, not contact screws
negative_option_QA.C: CONTRADICTED: feed-side wires do not attach to threaded socket under this source

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: Even a technically precise clause cannot certify a Grade I key when exact Grade I exam bibliography labels PE102 as NU
technical_case_records.grade_bibliography_note: ANRE official May 2023 bibliography item 22 labels PE102/1986: Grade I=NU, Grade II=DA

technical_case_records.original_stem: Utilizarea unei cuple longo-transversale se preferă atunci când dorim:

original_ABC_UNCHANGED.B: o siguranţă în funcţionare mai mare;

technical_case_records.source_exact_scope: IP71/2015 §5.2.4.3 and §5.2.4.3.1 public third-party indexed PDF; exact visual page not authenticated

negative_option_QA.A: NOT SUPPORTED as the chief purpose: maneuvers may become more complex with combined function
negative_option_QA.B: NOT AFFIRMATIVELY SUPPORTED as universal: neighboring section notes construction complexity, serious fault probability, unavailable multiple function when one is out
negative_option_QA.C: AFFIRMATIVE in technical source excerpt: economy of investment from reducing count of coupler bays

technical_case_records.scope_counterexample: A combined coupler may have operational benefits for a particular station, but a general assertion of greater safety without specified baseline cannot override the explicitly stated investment motive
